scope: P6 does not minimize total DeepSeek tokens. It tests whether high-budget Agent research spends context on decision-changing evidence rather than replaying settled material, while preserving exact durable history and requiring independent source/evidence re-grounding before a terminal causal claim can earn mutation authority. The six-trajectory matrix shows that non-replay sharply reduces repeated evidence, but compact incremental state and batch planning can still merge neighboring mechanisms or finalize the wrong causal locality. P6 therefore accepts a two-stage law: Agent-authored compact Working Views may guide high-budget discovery, but terminal causal claims remain proposals until independently re-grounded against exact source/evidence. No generic Memory/RAG, semantic-search planner, scheduler, DAG, evaluator service or RSI controller is productized.

tokenPolicy.optimizationTarget: decision-changing evidence utilization and causal fidelity
lowUtilizationExamples: replaying settled repository/evidence bytes without changing the next decision
requiring redundant nested JSON or duplicate evidence-reference fields from the model
ignoring Agent-selected observation slicing and returning the same bytes again
repeating exact-edit generation after semantic uncertainty has collapsed to a mechanical predicate

matrixInterpretation.conclusion: Removing repeated evidence is necessary but insufficient. Independent terminal re-grounding is required because low-replay protocols can still compress adjacent mechanisms into false causal claims.

providerIncremental.reason: The Agent merged contender preflight and known-outcome lease waiting into _acquire_provider_outcome_lease; exact source shows that function only owns bounded outcome-owner lease waiting and exact durable-call continuity.

providerBatch.reason: The Agent identified assert_dispatch_fence_current in Runtime Tool bridges as the P5 Provider-call concurrency repair. Exact source shows those calls fence Runtime Tool dispatch; the P5 Provider-call contender/outcome repair is in sqlite_run_store.py provider-call lifecycle paths.

causalSourceHardening.law: Malformed Harness conclusion control and Provider actions that never received Runtime Tool authority must be corrected before they can create Runtime Tool identities or Tool observations. A strict no-Tool bridge remains fail-closed; the correction path does not broaden Tool authority.

authorityLaw: High-budget Agent reasoning may use a compact, non-replaying Working View, but the compact state is revisable cognition rather than source truth. Any terminal causal claim must be independently re-grounded against exact evidence before it can authorize source mutation. Provider actions that never received Runtime Tool authority likewise cannot acquire Tool-history authority merely because correction is needed.
remainingBoundaries: P6 does not prove a universally optimal context policy or tokenizer-independent information metric.
Compact Agent state can merge adjacent mechanisms; independent re-grounding remains mandatory.
Batch planning can produce fast false finalization even with zero repeated evidence.
Replay can sometimes reach a valid abstention, but its large repeated evidence exposure is not justified by that result in these experiments.
The experiment-only runner, source generators and normalized-result recorder are not supported Harness APIs.
No generic Memory/RAG, semantic-search planner, Scheduler, Goal Stream, DAG, evaluator service or RSI controller was added.
